raw_excerpt: HTTP Archive Web Almanac 2025: Page Weight (Chapter 14, written by Richard Barret and Jamie Indigo, reviewed by Dave Smart, published 2026-01-15). 'In 2025, the median desktop home page used: 22 KB of HTML resources; 82 KB of CSS resources; 139 KB of fonts; 697 KB of JavaScript; 1,058 KB of images' (total ~2.86MB). 'In 2025, the median mobile home page used: 22 KB HTML, 77 KB CSS, 122 KB fonts, 632 KB JS, 911 KB images' (total ~2.56MB). 'Year over year, the median home page size grew 7.8% to 2.7 MB. The median mobile home page is 2.6 MB, growing 8.4% from 2.4 MB in 2024. In 2025, the median desktop page size reached 2.9 MB, up 7.3% from 2024.' 90th percentile desktop: 9,179 KB. 'All key information should be present in the initial raw HTML, since AI crawlers do not render JavaScript.'
